Title: Cinematic Radio Subtitles
Description: Cinematic, stereo-safe subtitles for original English Tower, LSO, and AWACS radio calls. The current transmission sits low in the VR view, keeping it readable without blocking the flight path or cockpit instruments. AWACS reports are compacted for quick reference; more radio roles are planned. Source: https://github.com/CMD137/Cinematic-Radio-Subtitles-for-VTOL-VR
